text:
Marisa: Quick follow-up from the lease-swap sims: we keep seeing requests lost when a region flip happens mid-request. Proposed mitigation: proxy writes an escrow record (durable, short lived) and becomes a delegate that replays to the eventual owner instead of doing a synchronous lease handoff. Thoughts?

alex: That reduces lost writes but adds a tail and local storage. How do we guarantee we don't double-apply or violate ordering?

marisa: Plan is at-least-once delivery with strong idempotency keys. Each write gets a stable write_token and shard_seq metadata. Target validates idempotency and sequence windows.

devon: Residency concerns: we cannot forward EU tenant data to non-EU. The escrow must carry residency_policy and the proxy must enforce routing policy before forward.

marisa: Exactly. Escrow entries include residency_policy and consent_flags. If no qualified destination exists, we mark escrow QUARANTINED and surface a ticket to ops for manual resolution.

sam: Single point risk: if the node holding escrow crashes during region outage we could lose the record. How to make escrow durable without big operational overhead?

marisa: Keep escrow small and replicated in-region (sync write to two local proxies). Also ship a lightweight index (metadata only) to control plane for visibility. TTLs short (default 3 mins) so capacity is bounded.

alex: Client impact? We should avoid blocking most callers. Proposed client contract?

marisa: Default path returns 202 + write_token after escrow write. Background forwarder handles apply. For clients that need strong durability we support a sync flag that waits for target acknowledgement (blocking). The write_token can be used to poll status or subscribe to webhook.

devon: Define SLAs: default completion SLO 30s p95, operator alert at 2m, quarantine threshold 5m. These drive autoscaling and perf tests.

nina: Observability: add metrics escrow_active, escrow_forward_rate, escrow_quarantines, replay_failures and traces with forward_attempt_id. Also capture tenant_id and residency_policy for compliance dashboards.

sam: For ordering across concurrent writers attach per-shard low-water/high-water seq bounds in escrow so target can detect gaps and fetch missing ops before applying replay.

marisa: We'll reuse shard_seq and include seq_span in the escrow payload. If a gap is detected target can request gap-fetch API or mark replay pending until fill arrives.

alex: Read-after-write consistency implications? If client reads from another region they may not observe the write until replayed. Guidance?

marisa: Documented behavior: eventual for default 202; apps needing R-A-W must use sync mode or read via origin-region proxy using X-Write-Token header. We'll provide a convenience read-through endpoint.

devon: Rollout: feature-flag escrow in proxy, metrics-only dark-launch, then limited canary for non-sovereign tenants, then expand to sovereign tenants once legal signs off. Incremental enablement per region.

sam: For operator ergonomics add an automated escrows dashboard, a manual forward button (with owner_hint), and a remediation job that tries operator-approved cross-region forward for quarantined items.

nina: Add audit events for every forward attempt and final disposition (applied/duplicate/quarantined/deleted). Export to long-term audit store for compliance and e-discovery.

alex: Edge-case: forward loops if owner_hint is stale. Need handshake with owner validation and a clear retry ceiling.

marisa: Handshake: forwarder POSTs /handoff with token; target verifies token signature and ownership; if ownership mismatch reply 409 with owner_hint. Forwarder will re-attempt routing once owner updates or escalate after retry_limit. Example snippet:

```http
POST /handoff HTTP/1.1
Host: region-eu1.proxy
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "write_token": "wt-ff12",
  "shard": "sh-007",
  "seq_span": [9001,9003],
  "residency_policy": "eu-only"
}
```

marisa: Tokens are signed by proxy key and carry a TTL to avoid replay/spoof. Target validates signature and timestamp.

ops-bot: [automation] escrow_replication=2; default_ttl_secs=180; forward_retry_limit=6; quarantine_retention_days=14.

sam: Data lifecycle: what if a tenant issues delete while write is escrowed? We must honor the delete in final state.

marisa: Delete will be persisted as an operation with its own seq. Replay will apply in seq order; if tombstone observed first, replayed write is deduped/skipped.

nina: Telemetry: include who triggered forward (proxy-id, operator-id), timestamps for escrowed_at, forwarded_at, applied_at, and final_status. Provide an export API for compliance.

alex: Rough implementation estimate: escrow API + storage shim + signer + forwarder worker + target handoff endpoint + dedupe = 4-6 weeks dev, 2 weeks integration, runbook + legal signoff parallel.

marisa: I'll draft a short RFC patch that defines escrow contract, token format, TTLs, metrics, and rollout phases. Proposal: prototype in staging for non-sovereign tenants within 2 sprints.

sam: :+1: Start with low-risk tenants.

devon: I'll draft operator failure-mode matrix and a playbook for quarantined escrows.

nina: I'll mock up dashboard tiles and audit export flows.

marisa: Thanks all 94 tagging @alex @devon @sam @nina. Will post RFC link when ready.
